protocol.instructions: Given the measured costs and convergence facts, choose the protocol to register for the large benchmarks.

criteria.a: Option A: full-budget benchmark at padding 4, refinement 1 declared as a sampled model, plus a separate DEV-only fidelity study at refinements 1,2,4,8.
criteria.b: Option B: full-budget benchmark at padding 2, refinement 4 (about 120 GPU-hours, still unconverged).
criteria.c: Option C: reduced-budget benchmark at padding 4, refinement 1 (10 epochs, 4-config grid) plus the fidelity study.
criteria.d: Option D: no large benchmarks, diagnostics and documentation only.

fidelity_core.instructions: Should the fidelity study (train at one refinement, evaluate the same masks at higher refinements and against direct Rayleigh-Sommerfeld) be treated as the main scientific contribution of the closure, above the benchmark accuracy numbers?

complete_c008.instructions: Is it worth spending about 3 CPU-hours to finish the pre-registered but interrupted historical CONTRATO-008 (baseline seeds 1-2 and the permuted-label control) before archiving it, given that its periodic-window model is superseded?

fashion_reuse.instructions: Is it acceptable to evaluate the new Fashion-MNIST protocol on the official test set that the earlier contract already examined, provided it is labelled as a re-used, non-fresh test?

need_second_opinion.instructions: Is there enough uncertainty to justify an independent second opinion before registering the protocol?
